name: Account
description: An account in the chart of accounts; a category tracking the company’s financial activity.

update.note: Sparse update; body must include Id and SyncToken.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object, assigned by QuickBooks. Required (in the body) for update operations.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: User-recognizable name for the account. Must be unique among all accounts and within its hierarchy level. Max 100 characters; cannot contain colon (:).

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object, used for optimistic concurrency control. Required (in the body) for update operations.

fields.name: AcctNum
fields.description: User-defined account number to help identify the account within the chart of accounts and to organize accounting reports. Shown only if the Account Numbers preference is enabled. Max 7 characters (US) / 20 (other locales).

fields.name: CurrencyRef
fields.description: Reference to the currency in which all amounts associated with this account are expressed. Editable only if multicurrency is enabled and there are no transactions against the account.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

fields.name: ParentRef
fields.description: Reference to the parent account when this account is a subaccount (SubAccount = true). Specifies the immediate parent in the account hierarchy.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Id of the parent Account object.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: User-entered description of the account, supplied to assist in identifying its purpose. Max 100 characters.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: Whether the account is active. Inactive accounts may be hidden from most display purposes and may not be used in financial transactions. Defaults to true.

fields.name: SubAccount
fields.description: Read-only system-defined flag indicating whether the account is a subaccount of another account. True if ParentRef is set.

fields.name: Classification
fields.description: Read-only categorization of the account, derived from AccountType. Indicates the account's high-level financial-statement grouping.

fields.name: FullyQualifiedName
fields.description: Read-only fully qualified name of the account, including the hierarchy of parent account names separated by colons (e.g., 'Utilities:Gas and Electric').

fields.name: TxnLocationType
fields.description: The account location, used in France locales. Valid values include WithinFrance, FranceOverseas, OutsideFranceWithEU, OutsideEU.

fields.name: AccountType
fields.description: A detailed account classification that specifies the use of this account. Either AccountType or AccountSubType is required on create; if omitted, it is derived from AccountSubType. Recommended on create.

fields.name: AccountSubType
fields.description: The account subtype classification, more granular than AccountType. Must be consistent with AccountType. If AccountType is omitted, AccountType is inferred from this value. The valid set depends on AccountType and locale.

fields.name: CurrentBalance
fields.description: Read-only system-computed current balance of the account, in the account's currency, excluding subaccounts.

fields.name: CurrentBalanceWithSubAccounts
fields.description: Read-only system-computed current balance of the account including the balances of all its subaccounts.

fields.name: TaxCodeRef
fields.description: Reference to the default tax code for the account. Applicable in non-US locales (e.g., UK, India, Global) where automated sales tax is enabled.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Id of the referenced TaxCode object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced tax code.

fields.name: AccountAlias
fields.description: An alias for the account, used in France locales. Max 100 characters.

fields.name: AccountPurposes
fields.description: Account purpose categories, used in France locales to map the account to standardized chart-of-accounts purposes.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Read-only descriptive system metadata about the entity, maintained by QuickBooks.

attributes.name: CreateTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was created, in ISO 8601 format.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was last modified, in ISO 8601 format.

fields.name: domain
fields.description: Read-only internal field identifying the originating QuickBooks domain. Value is always 'QBO'.

fields.name: sparse
fields.description: Read-only flag indicating whether the object is a sparse (partial) representation. When true on a request, only the supplied fields are updated.
